title: Drum with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum body -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='56' height='46' rx='4' fill='#e8523f'/>
  <!-- drum shell highlight -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='56' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff7a63'/>
  <!-- drum shell bottom shade -->
  <rect x='22' y='70' width='56' height='6' rx='3' fill='#b33424'/>
  <!-- top head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- top head rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='28' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#c9b088' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='28' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#f0a898' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- tension rods -->
  <line x1='26' y1='34' x2='26' y2='74' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='34' x2='74' y2='74' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a1020'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a1020'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='47.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='47.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 60 Q50 72 62 60' fill='none' stroke='#1a1020' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff9e8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff9e8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- drumsticks -->
  <line x1='18' y1='22' x2='38' y2='30' stroke='#d9a05b' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#f2c27a'/>
  <line x1='82' y1='22' x2='62' y2='30' stroke='#d9a05b' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#f2c27a'/>
</svg>
